The high-waist bikini bottoms with side gathering conceal the tummy area and create a slim silhouette. Removable soft pads and adjustable straps provide perfect support.
text.bullet_point#3.value: Occasion: Ideal for beach, pool, swimming pool, holiday, honeymoon, summer, sunbathing and all water activities, perfect for swimming and sunbathing. Also a stylish gift idea for girlfriend, family and girls.
text.bullet_point#4.value: Care instructions: Wash separately by hand in cold water, do not dry clean, do not bleach, do not wring, line dry and avoid direct sunlight – this keeps colour and shape.
